title: Book 6 — Erato, Chapter 124
paragraphs: It might perhaps be suggested that they had some grievance against the Athenian people and that for this reason they tried to betray their own city. But on the contrary, there were no men in higher repute among the Athenians than they, and none who had been more greatly honored. It is therefore not reasonable to suppose that they would have displayed a shield for any such purpose. That a shield was displayed cannot be denied — it was done. But as to who displayed it, I cannot say more than that.
